name: FASMC Bath Salts Body Massage Scrub - Rose - 380gm
description:
FASMC Bath Salts Body Massage Scrub - Rose - 380gm 
FASMC BATH SALTS BODY MASSAGE SCRUB: 
MAKE SKIN EJOY SPA. 
EXTRA WHITENING BATH SALTS. 
BOTH SALT IS RICH IN VARIETY OF HUMAN BODY TRACE ELEMENT REQUIRED: 
IT ADDS SPECIAL SKIN CARE. 
NGREDIENTS CAN HAVE A ROLE IN PURIFING THE AGING SKIN AND DEAD SKIN. 
COMPLETE REMOVAL OF THE SKIN. 
EXTRA HORNY. 
DUST. 
GREASE AND GENERAL BATH AGENT RESIDUES. 
BRINGS YOU FRESH AFTER BATHING ENJOYMENT.
